nodes.label: Intel Trust Domain Extensions (TDX)
nodes.description: Hardware-isolated execution environment architecture providing multi-key total memory encryption (MKTME) and cryptographic CPU state protection for sovereign confidential computing workloads.

nodes.label: AraBERT Pretrained Language Model
nodes.description: Transformer-based masked language model pre-trained on large-scale Arabic news corpora and OSian, utilized for downstream sovereign NLP tasks including NER, dialect identification, and semantic search.

nodes.label: PLONK Universal zk-SNARK Protocol
nodes.description: Permutations over Lagrange-bases for Oecumenical Noninteractive arguments of Knowledge (PLONK), providing zero-knowledge proofs with a universal and updatable trusted setup for knowledge graph state verification.

nodes.label: W3C OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Recommendation
nodes.description: Semantic web language designed to represent rich, complex knowledge about entities, taxonomies, and description logic relations, extending RDF Schema with advanced inference capabilities.

nodes.label: NVMe over Fabrics (NVMe-oF) RDMA Protocol
nodes.description: Storage networking protocol designed to connect hosts to non-volatile memory subsystems across a network fabric utilizing RDMA, enabling microsecond latency for distributed vector databases.
